s.n: Market stall fruit skewers with honey dip
s.note: the farmers market the gang plans to raid
s.how: Hull 250g strawberries, cube a quarter rockmelon, peel and cube 2 kiwi fruit and pick 250g grapes. Thread onto 12 skewers in rainbow order. Mix 250g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla. Toast 30g shredded coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden. Serve the skewers with the yoghurt dip and the coconut for dipping and rolling.

s.note: Barnabas's big dried fruit heist at the market
s.how: Mix 100g rolled oats, 100g almonds and 50g pumpkin seeds with 3 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp oil and 1 tsp cinnamon. Spread on a lined tray, press flat and bake at 160C for 20 minutes, stirring once. Cool completely so it clusters. Break up and toss with 80g chopped dried apricots, 60g dried apple and 60g dried cranberries.

m.n: Gloucester chicken, leek and bacon pie
m.note: Peter's trip into the city of Gloucester
m.how: Fry 3 diced rashers bacon, then add 800g diced chicken thigh and brown. Add 2 sliced leeks and 2 diced carrots and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer 15 minutes with thyme. Pour into a pie dish, top with 1 sheet puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 300g buttered peas.

w.note: the rabbits and their favourite vegetable
w.how: Mix 200g self-raising flour, 1 tsp bicarb, 2 tsp cinnamon, 180g brown sugar, 3 eggs, 180ml oil, 250g grated carrot and 60g chopped walnuts. Pour into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Cool. Beat 250g cream cheese with 60g butter and 250g icing sugar and spread on top. Tint a little icing orange to pipe small carrots and scatter with walnuts.

d.how: In a jug, mix 500ml cloudy apple juice, 300ml pear juice, the juice of 1 lemon and 1 tsp finely grated ginger. Chill 20 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with ice and thin apple slices, pour in the juice to two-thirds and top up with soda water. Stir and serve.
